evidence.quote: Patient must have confirmed unresectable liver confined metastatic colorectal cancer (CRC).
Patient must not have microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H) colorectal cancer.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Patients whose tumors are MSI-H or dMMR are excluded.
Any prior systemic chemotherapy, targeted therapy, or immunotherapy; or radiation therapy administered as treatment for colorectal cancer

labels.note: MSI-H and already on adjuvant capecitabine.

labels.label: excluded
labels.note: Resected stage II colon cancer on adjuvant therapy.

evidence.quote: Patients must have histologically confirmed solid malignancy that is metastatic or unresectable
Participants with locally advanced, recurrent or metastatic histologically confirmed HNSCC, NSCLC, ESCC, CRC

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Patients must have histologically confirmed and radiographically measurable metastatic colorectal adenocarcinoma with known BRAF V600E mutation
Patients must have received prior treatment with the combination of encorafenib and cetuximab.

labels.note: BRAF V600E fits but disease is resected, non-metastatic.

evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed invasive, well-moderately differentiated rectal adenocarcinoma, mismatch repair proficient.
Patients with histologically or cytologically confirmed metastatic CRC
Microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H) or mismatch repair deficient (dMMR) disease

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Completed treatment (i.e., neo-adjuvant, adjuvant cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiation, or surgical resection) at least six months prior
Scheduled to receive any form of cancer therapy during study participation

labels.note: Survivorship study; patient still on adjuvant capecitabine.

evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed recurrent unresectable, locally advanced, or metastatic CRC
